info.title: Movie Production API
info.description:
Companies, projects, people and roles for running a movie production.

**To try it:** create an account with `POST /auth/signup` (or use one you have), call `POST /auth/signin`, then click **Authorize** and paste the `access_token`.

Every request runs as the signed-in person, and the database's security rules decide what they can see and change.

get.summary: A personal call sheet link: the sent call sheet, view only, with no sign-in
get.description: Each person called on a day has their own link token (ShootDayCall.link_token). Whoever has the link can read that day's sent call sheet and see which call is theirs (`me`); nothing can be changed through it. Opening it counts as that person viewing the sent version. Unknown links, and sheets not sent yet, give 404.
